title_lines: HOLLAND, 1421 🌷🌧️ The storm rises and two waters press the dyke.
The keeper must walk the crest — the one line that stays high
while the land falls away east and west. Find it by ear. 🎧
question: Which sound is the crest — where a whole LINE of musicians shares the top note? 🌧️
hint_lines: On the crest, walking north–south changes NOTHING —
friends ahead of you and behind you sing your exact note. 💡
Does the highest note live at one point… or along a whole row?

options.label: A
options.explain: EVERY direction was dead there — one note everywhere, a flat floor. On the dyke, one direction holds still but the other falls to the water. 🙂

options.label: B
options.explain: So close! That peak falls away in EVERY direction — its top note lives at a single point. The crest's top note stretches along a whole line. 🙂

options.label: D
options.explain: That was the dyke's SLOPE — the music leaned down toward the water. Climb until the highest voices sing right beside you, ahead and behind. 🙂

success_text: THE CREST! 🌧️ North–south the music froze — that whole line sings one note, and only east–west falls away. You just heard a direction where nothing changes. Remember it. 🎉
